blocks.title: Deployment
blocks.text: Once the software has been thoroughly tested and any issues fixed, it moves to deployment: making the software available for users to access and use.

items: Installation: the software is installed on the user's system or server, often by running an installation program that copies files and sets up configurations.
Configuration: the software is adjusted to the user's or organization's needs, such as user preferences, network settings and database connections.
Testing in the real world: after installation the software is tested in its real environment to make sure it works with other systems and meets user needs.

blocks.text: Deploying software is like opening a new store: once everything is set up, you welcome customers (users) to start using your product (Did You Know).
